question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
-- Calculate total income:
-- Meatlovers (pizza_id=1) = $12 each
-- Vegetarian (pizza_id=2) = $10 each
-- Each extra topping = $1
-- Filter out canceled orders (cancellation IS NULL or empty)
-- The extras column stores comma-separated topping IDs, so count commas + 1 to get number of extras
-- But we need to handle NULL/empty extras

SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN p.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 12
            WHEN p.pizza_name = 'Vegetarian' THEN 10
        END
        + COALESCE(
            CASE 
                WHEN c.extras IS NULL OR c.extras = '' THEN 0
                ELSE (LENGTH(c.extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.extras, ',', '')) + 1)
            END,
            0
        )
    ) as total_income
FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders c
JOIN pizza_names p ON c.pizza_id = p.pizza_id
JOIN pizza_runner_orders r ON c.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE r.cancellation IS NULL OR r.cancellation = '';
